# Glossary

Every term the instances in this repository define, as W3C SKOS. Terms link to the external concepts they match rather than copying them. 7 terms from 1 glossary, plus the sources below.

<h2 id="letter-A">A</h2>
<dl class="fa-gloss">
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--actor" data-fa-gloss="actor  ">
actor
</dt>
<dd>
<p>A concrete participant, human, agentic or mechanical, that persists across every process and takes on roles. Which login is which actor is the data store's to know.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/actor</code> · source <code>cat-harness/skills/folio-core/role-model.md</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>closeMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Agent">www.w3.org/ns/prov#Agent</a></li></ul>
</dd>
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--associated-harness" data-fa-gloss="associated harness  ">
associated harness
</dt>
<dd>
<p>A harness this one knows by name, site and repository, and never loads, builds or copies. The fourth relation beside depends (needs), references (remoteGraphs) and utilizes (dependencies).</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/associated-harness</code> · source <code>cat-harness/schemas/cat-harness.ts#AssociatedHarness</code></p>

</dd>
</dl>

<h2 id="letter-G">G</h2>
<dl class="fa-gloss">
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--glossary" data-fa-gloss="glossary  ">
glossary
</dt>
<dd>
<p>An instance's terms and what they mean, as a SKOS concept scheme: local terms linked to external concepts, plus external concepts listed without being copied.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/glossary</code> · source <code>folio-assistant-core/schemas/glossary.ts</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>closeMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#ConceptScheme">www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#ConceptScheme</a></li></ul>
</dd>
</dl>

<h2 id="letter-P">P</h2>
<dl class="fa-gloss">
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--permission" data-fa-gloss="permission  ">
permission
</dt>
<dd>
<p>One ODRL rule allowing an assignee an action, optionally on a target and within constraints. A permission to a broader action permits every action included in it.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/permission</code> · source <code>cat-harness/schemas/odrl.ts</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>exactMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Permission">www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Permission</a></li></ul>
</dd>
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--policy" data-fa-gloss="policy  ">
policy
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Which Actor may do which action, and where, written as W3C ODRL 2.2 permission and prohibition rules scoped by Process, Task and Role.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/policy</code> · source <code>cat-harness/schemas/odrl.ts</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>exactMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Policy">www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/Policy</a></li></ul>
</dd>
</dl>

<h2 id="letter-R">R</h2>
<dl class="fa-gloss">
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--role" data-fa-gloss="role  ">
role
</dt>
<dd>
<p>The swimlane: a persona an actor takes on because of the lane it is acting in, carrying the skills that lane's activities need.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/role</code> · source <code>cat-harness/skills/folio-core/role-model.md</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>closeMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Role">www.w3.org/ns/prov#Role</a></li></ul>
</dd>
</dl>

<h2 id="letter-T">T</h2>
<dl class="fa-gloss">
<dt id="folio-assistant-core--platform--task-run" data-fa-gloss="task run  ">
task run
</dt>
<dd>
<p>One performance of a BPMN task by an Actor in a Role under a policy, recorded as a W3C PROV-O activity whose plan is the task.</p>
<p class="fa-gloss-meta">Folio Assistant platform terms · <code>https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/folio-assistant-core/ns#glossary/platform/task-run</code> · source <code>cat-harness/schemas/prov.ts</code></p>
<ul class="fa-gloss-matches"><li>closeMatch: <a href="http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Activity">www.w3.org/ns/prov#Activity</a></li></ul>
</dd>
</dl>
